The declining revenue, continued losses, and slight decrease in profitability margin are concerning and outweigh the positive contributions from increased shareholder equity. While some efficiency improvements are indicated by the EPS increase, the fundamental challenges remain. The reduced asset base also indicates a reduction in size.
